rule_title: TTP T1546.008 - IFEO debugger set for sethc.exe (sticky keys backdoor)
description: Detects reg.exe creating or modifying the Image File Execution Options Debugger value for sethc.exe, pointing it to cmd.exe. This is the classic sticky keys backdoor — pressing Shift 5 times at the login screen spawns a SYSTEM command prompt instead of the accessibility dialog. In the observed data, reg.exe set HKLM\...\IFEO\sethc.exe\Debugger = C:\windows\system32\cmd.exe.
